drab.definition:
s. lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
s. lacking brightness or color; dull
drab.translation: a. 土褐色的, 单调的

draba.translation: [网络] 葶苈属；山荠属；德拉巴

drabbed.translation:
a. 单调的；土褐色的
n. 浅褐色；无生气；邋遢；小额
vt. 使无生气
vi. 嫖妓
n. (Drab)人名；(匈)德劳布；(法)德拉布

drabber.definition: n. One who associates with drabs; a wencher.
drabber.translation: a. 土褐色的( drab的比较级 ); 无生气的; 乏味的; 单调的

drabbest.definition:
s. lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
s. lacking brightness or color; dull
s. of a light brownish green color
drabbest.translation: a. 土褐色的( drab的最高级 ); 无生气的; 乏味的; 单调的

drabbet.definition: n. A coarse linen fabric, or duck.

drabbing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Drab
drabbing.translation:
a. 单调的；土褐色的
n. 浅褐色；无生气；邋遢；小额
vt. 使无生气
vi. 嫖妓
n. (Drab)人名；(匈)德劳布；(法)德拉布

drabble.definition:
v. t. To draggle; to wet and befoul by draggling; as, to
   drabble a gown or cloak.
v. i. To fish with a long line and rod; as, to drabble for
   barbels.
drabble.translation:
vt. 拖脏, 弄得满身泥
vi. 在泥淖中走

drabbled.translation:
vt. 弄得满身泥；拖脏
vi. 拖泥溅水行走
n. (Drabble)人名；(英)德拉布尔

drabbler.definition:
n. A piece of canvas fastened by lacing to the bonnet of a
   sail, to give it a greater depth, or more drop.
drabbler.translation:
vt. (在泥水中)将(衣服等)拖湿(或拖脏), 使(衣服)又湿又脏：
vi. 变得又湿又脏, 变湿, 变脏：；在泥淖中行走：

drabbling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Drabble
drabbling.translation:
vt. 弄得满身泥；拖脏
vi. 拖泥溅水行走
n. (Drabble)人名；(英)德拉布尔

drably.translation: adv. 单调乏味地, 无生气地, 无光彩地

drabness.definition: n having a drab or dowdy quality; lacking stylishness or elegance

drabs.definition:
plural of drab
s. lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
s. lacking brightness or color; dull
drabs.translation: (drab 的复数) a. 土褐色的, 单调的
